<td class="text"><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;"><strong>NOTE 7. SHARE CAPITAL</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">The Company is authorized to issue 100,000,000 shares of common stock, $0.0001 par value per share. As of March 31, 2026, 8,800,000 shares were issued and outstanding (2025: 7,000,000).</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">On November 19, 2025, the Company issued 100,000 common stocks as seed shares for total proceeds of $100 ($0.001 per share).</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">On January 15, 2026, the Company issued 7,000,000 common stock to acquire 100% interest of Dance Emotion Limited as its wholly owned subsidiary (See Note 5).</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">On January 31, 2026, the Company closed a private placement and issued 1,700,000 common stocks for gross proceeds of $85,000 ($0.05 per share).</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">As of March 31, 2026, the Company had 8,800,000 shares of common stock issued and outstanding.</p><span></span>
</td>
